protocol.decode: upstream cached forward with deterministic first-index argmax; cfg=1, FP16 CUDA autocast; float32 RGB mean, no color matching
protocol.aggregation: per-image metric, then equal-weight mean over eligible images
protocol.native_contrast: mean absolute error in per-component core-minus-ring contrast; 8-connected native mask components, 5x5 square dilation clipped to valid pixels with all native components excluded from ring
protocol.column_residual: population SD of mean background error for columns with >=8 background pixels; requires at least two columns
